2026-10-09. Independent reviewer covariant_review_sol.
No tensor_frame_sol/spin1_escalation/ or new originator derivation read.
Prior covariant/spin1 blind and exposed packets are preserved unchanged.

VERDICT
The supplied stronger tensor claim is TRUE, with an explicit quadratic
form on the tensor product of supplied test spans. No local channel or
compression need be HS-self-adjoint, normal, or test-span preserving.
The essential construction is a HALF MIXTURE of TWO product canonical
comparators: right-singular and left-singular. Direct tensorization of
the symmetric parts, or domination of a nonnormal map by its right
modulus alone, is not the proof. Qubit factors give the full global
Hermitian algebra. Constant2 is sharp already for one qubit.

THEOREM AND INTERFACE
At each of finitely many sites j, supply a unital CPTP Phi_j:M_dj->M_dj
and a CPTP B_j:M_dj->M_dj tensor M_dj whose two marginals equal Phi_j.
Supply a local real Hermitian test span S_j, either
 (a) span_R{I,J1,J2,J3} in the vector spin1 representation on M3; or
 (b) span_R{I,Gamma1,...,Gammam}, with supplied traceless Hermitian
     involutions Gamma_a satisfying {Gamma_a,Gamma_b}=2 delta_ab I.
No irreducibility or maximal Clifford family is required. Repeated
identity generators, if any, are removed rather than treated as
traceless Clifford coordinates. Empty traceless spans are trivial.
Let D=product_j d_j, Phi=tensor_j Phi_j, and S=tensor_R,j S_j, identified
with its real subspace of Hermitian M_D. Then there is ONE pure canonical
EB channel Psi, unital/CPTP/HS-self-adjoint, chosen for the supplied local
channels and spans, such that EVERY A in S obeys
 tau_D(A^2)-tau_D[A Psi(A)]
       <=2{tau_D(A^2)-tau_D[A Phi(A)]}.                    (T)

terms. Phi_j may send local test observables outside S_j. No comparator
chosen separately for A is used. The theorem is an existence statement;
an efficient algorithm for acquiring the spin1 ensembles is not supplied.
